def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    # Find the colored code bar, whose cells are arranged in repeated rows or columns.
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r][c] not in (0,1) for c in range(w))]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in (0,1) for r in range(h))]
    seq=[]
    if rows:
        r=rows[0]
        rowseq=[grid[r][c] for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
        if len(set(rowseq))>1:
            seq=list(dict.fromkeys(rowseq))
        else:
            seq=list(dict.fromkeys(grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,1)))
    if 1 not in seq:
        seq=[1]+seq
    k=seq.index(1); dh=r1-r0+1
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,color in enumerate(seq):
        top=r0+(i-k)*dh
        for dr,dc in shape:
            rr,cc=top+dr,c0+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=color
    return out
